user.title: Connect to Edibl
user.description: Enter your Edibl URL. If Edibl runs as the Home Assistant add-on, map its port and use the add-on host. A long-lived API token (edbl_…) is optional when Edibl runs in single-tenant mode.

hassio_confirm.title: Edibl add-on discovered
hassio_confirm.description: Set up the Edibl add-on at {host}? It runs in single-tenant mode, so no token is needed.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Edibl at that URL.

abort.already_configured: This Edibl instance is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: The discovered Edibl add-on didn't provide a reachable address.

init.title: Edibl options
init.description: How often Home Assistant refreshes data from Edibl.

consume.name: Consume stock
consume.description: Record consumption of stock (eat, discard, etc.).

name.name: Product name
name.description: Name of the product to consume. Required if product_id is not provided.

product_id.name: Product ID
product_id.description: Product ID to consume directly (skips name resolution). Required if name is not provided.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Unit of measure (optional, auto-detected if omitted).

locationId.name: Location ID
locationId.description: Limit consumption to a specific location (optional).
